_note: Batch 10: ten REAL Perth community and support organisations researched from public information on 10 Aug 2026. Introduces the 'community' practice category: men's groups, women's circles, meditation groups, addiction recovery meetings, peer support groups and wellness meetups. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. Copy discipline is strictest here — recovery and peer-support organisations are described by what a meeting IS (format, schedule, cost, who may attend), never by outcomes; no therapeutic, diagnostic or 'evidence-based' marketing language is repeated. Cosmic Radiance (women's circles) was researched and excluded: their circles are on hold until mid-2026.

listings.name: Tough Guy Book Club — Perth Chapter
listings.address: Hyde Park Hotel, 331 Bulwer Street, West Perth WA 6005
listings.blurb: A men's book club that meets at the Hyde Park Hotel at 7pm on the first Wednesday of every month, part of a network of pub-based chapters running since 2012. One book a month, no lectures, no phones — just men talking about the book and whatever the book opens up.
listings._source: toughguybookclub.com/perth_wa — venue, address, first-Wednesday 7pm schedule and upcoming dates confirmed; no public phone, email is not published in plain text

listings.name: The Men's Table (WA)
listings.blurb: A national non-profit that organises 'tables' of eight to twelve men who share a monthly dinner and honest conversation. New members start with an Entree — a one-off dinner that shows how a table works — with WA Entrees run around Perth, including South Perth.
listings._source: themenstable.org — table format (8–12 men, monthly meal) and WA Entree events confirmed; South Perth Entree also listed on Act Belong Commit. Only named-person partnership contacts are published, so phone/email left blank

listings.name: Lionheart Yoga & Sound Healing
listings.blurb: Lyndal runs a monthly women's circle on the last Saturday of the month, 7–9pm, at the Fremantle Yoga Centre space on Petra Street. Evenings move through grounding meditation with sound, yin yoga, a cacao ritual and guided sharing by candlelight, with themes following the seasons and moon phases.
listings._source: lionheartcircle.com/womens-circle — facilitator, venue (89 Petra St Bicton), last-Saturday 7–9pm schedule, $40–50 pricing and session contents confirmed; booking is via Ticket Tailor, no phone/email published. Runs AT the Fremantle Yoga Centre venue but is a separate business from that existing listing

listings.name: GROW WA
listings.blurb: Peer-run mutual support groups for mental wellbeing, meeting weekly for two hours followed by refreshments, with members keeping in touch between meetings. Groups run face to face around Perth and online as eGrow, and the free-call line connects you with the nearest group.
listings._source: grow.org.au and communitygroups.com.au listing — weekly two-hour meeting format, North Perth office, phone, free-call 1800 558 268 and email confirmed; groups are free to attend

listings.name: Alcoholics Anonymous Perth
listings.address: Room 10, Claisebrook Lotteries House, 33 Moore Street, East Perth WA 6004
listings.blurb: The Perth Central Service Office for AA in Western Australia, with meetings running every day of the week across the metro and country WA. Meetings are free, anonymous and open to anyone with a desire to stop drinking; the office is staffed weekdays 9am–4.30pm and the helpline answers around the clock.
listings._source: aaperthwa.org — office address, weekday hours, 24-hour helpline numbers (08 9325 3566 / 1300 22 22 22) and metro-wide meeting list confirmed; membership wording ('a desire to stop drinking') is AA's own stated requirement, not an outcome claim

listings.name: Palmerston Association
listings.blurb: A WA alcohol-and-other-drug support organisation running free recovery-focused groups across the metro — SMART Recovery meetings in Perth, Fremantle, Armadale, Thornlie and Rockingham, an online LGBTQIA+SB group, and SMART Family & Friends sessions for people supporting someone else. Most groups need no booking: just come along.
listings._source: palmerston.org.au/services/groups — group names, suburbs, free cost and no-booking policy confirmed; branch phone numbers vary by site so none recorded

listings.name: Holyoake
listings.blurb: A long-running WA counselling organisation whose free SMART Recovery groups meet across the Perth metro, north-east metro and Wheatbelt. Sessions are peer-led and structured around practical skills — motivation, urges, weekly goals — and are open to the public with no bookings or fees.
listings._source: holyoake.org.au — head office address, free no-booking SMART groups, regions covered, phone and email confirmed

listings.name: Brahma Kumaris Perth
listings.blurb: A volunteer-run meditation centre teaching Raja Yoga meditation through free introductory courses, public talks and workshops, with an ongoing Thursday evening class for those who have completed the intro course. All courses, classes and retreats are offered free of charge.
listings._source: brahmakumaris.org.au/new/perth-meditation — Cannington address, phone, email, free-of-charge policy and Thursday class confirmed

listings.name: The Perth Walking Group
listings.blurb: A social walking group that has been going for more than ten years, with 60–90 minute walks most Saturday and Sunday mornings at rotating spots around Perth, usually finishing with coffee. All fitness levels welcome — it is as much about meeting people as covering ground.
listings._source: meetup.com/perth-city-walking-group — 10+ year history, weekend-morning 60–90 minute walk format and coffee afterwards confirmed from the group page; contact is via Meetup only

listings.name: Heart Foundation Walking — Perth
listings.blurb: Free, volunteer-led local walking groups run under the Heart Foundation's national walking program, with groups meeting on regular weekly schedules across the Perth metro. Join online, pick a group near you, and walk — no cost, no equipment, all paces.
listings._source: walking.heartfoundation.org.au Perth locator — free volunteer-led group model and Perth groups confirmed; individual group times vary, contact via the online finder
